profile.description: Agent profile configuration including name and type (htn, rl, custom)

agent_type.description: Type of agent: htn, rl, or custom

minecraft_version.description: The version of Minecraft to use. Set to 'auto' to automatically detect the version.

host.description: The minecraft server host address to connect to

port.description: The minecraft server port to connect to. -1 for auto-detect.

load_memory.description: Whether to load agent's previous memory from file

init_message.description: Optional initial message or command to send on startup

chat_ingame.description: Whether to show agent's messages in game chat

narrate_behavior.description: Whether to chat automatic behavior like 'Collecting wood', 'Mining stone', etc.

render_bot_view.description: Whether to render bot view for observation at localhost:3000+

task.description: Task configuration object. Structure depends on agent type.

spawn_timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait for bot spawn before throwing error

metrics_enabled.description: Enable collection of performance metrics (steps, time, exploration)

metrics_export_path.description: Path to export metrics JSON files. Null for no export.
